limits: The verified Conduent corporate identifiers do not prove that any individual court debt was securitized.
Historical FARE fee allocation ($10.50 Conduent / $38.50 AOC) does not establish the same split applied in 2025–2026.
Fidelity/FMR searches produced name-matching candidates but no verified bridge to the court matter, FARE account, or payments.
A public-company parent, LEI, CIK, or ISIN does not by itself prove that a specific court payment entered securities markets.
The current evidentiary goal is transaction-level proof: case ledger → FARE referral/payment → vendor/remittance → exact legal entity.
